# shim

> shim is a B2B AI gateway that sits between applications and the OpenAI, Anthropic and Google APIs (Azure OpenAI included; Amazon Bedrock in enterprise). Callers keep the provider's own SDK and change only its base URL. shim masks personal data and secrets before a request leaves and restores them in the answer, applies rate, token and catalog admission, accounts tokens and cost per request, and returns provider-native payloads, errors and streams. The community gateway (Apache-2.0) needs no external services; the enterprise edition (Elastic-2.0, under `ee/`) adds tenants, budgets, audit evidence and private model deployments.

- [Finding schema](docs/FINDINGS_SCHEMA.md): the versioned JSON shape of every finding
- [v0.4.1 release notes](docs/releases/v0.4.1.md): the embeddings fix with transforms on, and skipped images in the downscale record
- [v0.4.0 release notes](docs/releases/v0.4.0.md): breaking changes, migrations, rollback and new settings
- [Current architecture](docs/CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE.md): the request path, product boundaries, error codes and contracts
- [Developer guide](DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md): where code lives, runtime invariants and the required gates
